observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT
Safety: CAUTION
Issues: Lateral-only image shows small metallic clips anteriorly, but left-versus-right lung location cannot be reliably determined because both lungs are superimposed; the “L” marker is a projection marker and does not by itself confirm the clips are in the left lung.
Suggestion: Confirm laterality with a frontal radiograph or the original radiology report before accepting “left lung”; otherwise report as surgical clips with laterality undetermined.
